static_policy.facades: all six masks and each per-instance valid static BlockState material
static_policy.facade_support_set: all 24 explicit whitelist families plus a bounded static full-cube-witness material lane; optional #c:glass_blocks and ordinary FacadeItem-eligible states require one live unrotated 0..16 six-face full-cube witness, while bounded additional static elements and multipart source quads remain admitted subject to the UV, tint, weighted-variant and semantic-resource gates; otherwise-valid complex static models fall back atomically; the 11 AE2-native neutral resource pins are not the complete support set
static_policy.facade_tint: zero or one distinct nonnegative source tint index is accepted; untinted layers may coexist; shared tinted layers use the host block-color calculator; mixed nonnegative tint indexes fall back atomically
static_policy.facade_uv_reinterpolation: QuadReInterpolator projects both source and post-clamp/post-corner-kick vertices onto the nominal-face dx/dy axes before InterpHelper bilinear interpolation; the bounded host lane requires an exact complete projected InterpHelper grid and falls back atomically instead of substituting a 3D planar solve
static_policy.facade_cardinal_variant_transform: exact signed-permutation quarter-turn blockstate variant geometry/vector and uvlock coordinate transforms avoid host floating-point matrix drift before the source-exact InterpHelper grid check
static_policy.facade_weighted_variants: exact minecraft:stone retains the frozen M2 geometry-and-material BlueMap position projection and does not claim pixel-identical client-randomized mirrored/rotated UVs; every other weighted set must collapse across all alternatives to one bounded static geometry/material/UV descriptor or fall back atomically
static_policy.facade_neutral_solid_render: exact pinned BlockState.isSolidRender for all 24 explicit whitelist neutral/default states; false only for ae2:quartz_glass, ae2:quartz_vibrant_glass and minecraft:honey_block; minecraft:soul_sand is true because its occlusion shape is full despite its 14/16 collision height
static_policy.facade_whitelist_state_validation: all 24 explicit whitelist families require the exact complete persisted property key set and source-declared value domains before rendering; the 13 vanilla families preserve valid states, the 11 AE2-native families apply the declared static normalization, and missing, extra or out-of-domain properties fall back atomically
static_policy.facade_whitelist_state_classification: BlockState.isSolidRender and same-state BlockState.skipRendering are family-invariant across all 554 valid explicit-whitelist states; booleans carried by the neutral/default row apply to the whole family, and any classification drift falls back atomically
static_policy.facade_skip_rendering: exact same-state BlockState.skipRendering table for all 24 explicit whitelist IDs is true only for both AE2 quartz-glass families and minecraft:honey_block; AE2 quartz glass additionally skips cross-family quartz/vibrant pairs with equal render shape; exact gallery controls are minecraft:glass=true, minecraft:oak_log=false and minecraft:oak_leaves=false; other ordinary/tag materials use the bounded BlueMap cullingIdentical plus exact-state host projection
static_policy.facade_corner_kick_units: QuadCornerKicker EPSILON is 0.00001 block units; runtime FacadeGeometry compares 0.00016 sixteenth units; PRBM analyzer positions remain block units and compare 0.00001
static_policy.native_facade_normalization: controller normalizes to offline/block; crafting families normalize formed/powered false; monitor preserves any valid facing and normalizes formed/powered false plus spin 0; unknown, extra or malformed properties fall back atomically
static_policy.facade_cutout: union of every installed oriented part collision box intersecting the current facade slab; the same-side short cable anchor does not intersect its facade; Minecraft AABB normalizes each generated strip endpoint pair with min/max, so transparent inset plus a boundary-reaching cutout can reverse endpoints and still yields a normalized strip rather than a degenerate strip
static_policy.plane_connection_coordinate_spaces: PlaneConnections bits are logical front-view up8/right4/down2/left1; PlaneBakedModel uses the separately preserved visual-local minX=right/maxX=left/minY=down/maxY=up table before QuadRotator maps it into installed-world space; PlaneConnectionHelper collision boxes use the exact face-aware BusCollisionHelper installed-face-local table, and bounds are never reused across those coordinate spaces
static_policy.facade_directional_shade: source BakedQuad shade is semantic-hash locked and shade=false remains eligible; BlueMap 5.22 PRBM has no per-quad shade channel, so directional shade is an accepted host-projection limitation rather than a pixel-exact claim
static_policy.facade_ambient_occlusion_direction: BlueMap ResourceModelRenderer uses source faceDir rotated only by the blockstate variant for AO neighbor lookup; element rotation affects vertices and nominal geometry but not AO direction; runtime uses the retained layer lightFace rather than quad nominal face
static_policy.structural_map_color_illumination: BlueMap map-color illumination uses original center and outward world light only; element lightEmission affects emitted triangle blocklight but does not brighten map color
static_policy.quartz_facade: facade-aware connected GlassState observes six neighbor positions including neighbor cable-bus facade appearance through RENDERING_FACADE_DIRECTION; another facade on the same cable bus is not a GlassState input, while local perpendicular facades separately affect FacadeBuilder mask/inset; both quartz and vibrant facade quads emit 0 even though the vibrant source block light level is 15
static_policy.attached_devices: 30 native endpoints requiring the exact serialized block-entity ID and source-declared persisted side/state/topology rule before AECableType minimum local/endpoint connection family
static_policy.endpoint_state_validation: all 30 endpoints require the exact complete persisted BlockState key set and each serialized value to be inside its source-declared domain; missing, extra or invalid properties use malformed-native atomic fallback even for ALL side rules
static_policy.known_extension_grid_node_hosts: 67 exact block/serialized-BE pairs across four pack-pinned artifacts force compatible UNKNOWN atomic original-resource fallback until their independent extension routes land; a catalog block with missing or wrong BE is malformed UNKNOWN but is not admitted compatible; an unrelated block carrying a catalog BE remains disconnected
static_policy.fallback: missing, malformed, capped, transient-only, or unsupported observations use atomic original-resource fallback
static_policy.excluded: machine contents, held items, fluids, live activity and accurate Drive LED states
